Variance is a component of the total prediction error decomposition.
Irreducible noise is a component of prediction error that cannot be eliminated.
Variance is defined using the mathematical expectation operator.
Regularization adds constraints to objective functions to prevent model overfitting.
Lasso regression uses the L1 norm constraint as its penalty.
Ridge regression uses the L2 norm constraint as its penalty.
Elastic Net combines both Lasso and Ridge regularization penalties.
Elastic Net combines both Ridge and Lasso regularization penalties.
Validation sets are used to evaluate best performing hyperparameter configurations.
Lasso performs feature selection by shrinking small weights to zero.

Natural log is a specific logarithmic function with base e.
Autograd is a Python library used to automatically compute derivatives.
Bernoulli is a special case of Categorical with two outcomes.
Discrete Uniform is a Categorical distribution with equal probabilities.
Standard Normal is a special Gaussian with mean 0 and variance 1.
MLE uses monotonic log transformations to optimize joint likelihood.
Bandwidth h controls smoothness and overfitting in KDE.

Rejection Sampling relies on drawing samples from a proposal distribution.
Importance weights are a core mathematical component of Importance Sampling.

Entropy is the expected value of self-information across a distribution.
Cross entropy equals entropy plus KL divergence between distributions.
KL divergence is calculated as cross entropy minus entropy.
Gibbs' inequality proves KL divergence is always non-negative.
Discrete entropy is a specific variant of entropy for discrete variables.
Continuous entropy is a specific variant of entropy for continuous variables.
Classification is a main subcategory of supervised learning.
Euclidean distance is a distance metric used to identify neighbors.
Distance-Weighted K-NN is a specific variant of K-NN.
The sigmoid function maps linear outputs to probabilities in logistic regression.
Cross entropy serves as the loss function for logistic regression.
Confusion matrix provides the counts used to evaluate classification performance.
N-grams are context-preserving sequence extensions of bag of words features.
Unigram is a specific variant of N-gram where n equals one.
Bigram is a specific variant of N-gram where n equals two.

Logistic function is a core component used to model probabilities.
LogLoss is derived by taking the negative log of likelihood.

Linearly Separable Classifier is a basic variant of Support Vector Machine.
Vector normalization is the process used to obtain a unit vector.
Support vectors are the closest data points that bound the margin.
The optimal hyperplane is identified by maximizing the margin.
Soft-Margin SVM is a variant that allows margin violations.
Decision trees are a specific variant of non-parametric models.
Conditional entropy calculates entropy after observing another variable.
Information gain is defined using entropy minus conditional entropy.
Information gain subtracts conditional entropy from initial entropy.
Decision trees choose dataset splits that maximize information gain.
Pure nodes are terminal nodes in decision trees with zero entropy.
Covariance generalizes variance to measure how two features vary together.
Correlation is created by scaling covariance using standard deviations.
Mutual Information is calculated as the KL divergence between joint and product distributions.
Normalized Mutual Information scales Mutual Information to a range between 0 and 1.

The eigenvectors of the covariance matrix are called principal components.
The centering matrix is used to transform raw data into centered data.

LDA is a task-aligned alternative to PCA for dimensionality reduction.

Inner product generalizes the dot product to abstract vector spaces.

Matrix Hadamard product extends element-wise vector multiplication to matrices.

The feature map is formed by applying basis functions to inputs.

Polynomial regression uses nonlinear basis functions within linear regression framework.
Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm used to minimize MSE.

Min-Max Scaling is a specific feature scaling technique in pre-processing.

The determinant determines whether a matrix inverse exists.

Continuous random variable is a specific type of random variable.

PDF measures probability behavior for continuous random variables.

Conditional probability is computed using joint and marginal probabilities.

High variance causes a model to overfit data.
